description: Shots fired upward from row 1 of level index 11 (PCMAP3.HUF, columns 20-31 have open row-0 cells) fly above the map for one frame. The original is stopped right after each of these probes and the word it read is compared with the port model.

emulator.loadSegment: 01F5 (PSP 01E5). The word at 2EF5:1C9D is a relocated segment, so the reads 5 and 6 pixels above the map depend on it

recipe: Fresh instance, mount C: = .work/dos, type C:, ALIEN and three keys at the passcode prompt.
Execute breakpoint at live 01F5:1830 with cs:[8716] = 2 (attract demo): set AX = 11, so the demo plays level index 11.
Execute breakpoint at live 01F5:1F8D with cs:[8716] = 2: write the inputs to 01F5:8719 and player 1 x, y (1236:BE1C) = 424 and the run start y (40, 39 or 38).
Execute breakpoint at live 01F5:539E (after CALL 3C08 in the shot update) with DX < 16: BX is the probe x, DX the probe y (shot y + 0x10), [AF82] the word read from DS:DI.

alignment.rule: A stop in the pass with [AF84] = N is compared with the port state after N - 2 steps (the shot update runs before that pass changes the map).
alignment.negativeControl: the earlier rule (1-3 pixels above read row 0) must differ
